chunks: Indeed, ʿAlī عليه السلام held a man liable who had injured a Christian's pig.

key_terms.خِنْزِيرَ: a pig, the damaged property in this case
key_terms.رَجُلًا: a man held responsible for the damage
key_terms.ضَمَّنَ: he imposed liability or required compensation
key_terms.عَلِيّاً: Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام, the authority issuing the ruling
key_terms.نَصْرَانِيٍّ: a Christian, the owner of the pig

ai.seo_question: Did Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام rule that a person must compensate for harming a Christian's pig?
ai.summary: This report states that Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام imposed liability on a man who caused harm to a Christian's pig. It indicates a legal ruling concerning compensation for damage to the property of a non-Muslim under protection.
